events.verdict: Thomspon (DET) reaches in and immediately retracts his hand away from Young (ATL). Young accentuates the marginal contact and it does not affect his SQBR.
Krejci (ATL) brings his arm around Cunningham (DET) as he makes a move to the basket, but the contact is marginal.
Duren (DET) reaches for the ball and brushes Okongwu's (ATL) arm as he defends Okongwu's layup attempt.
Beasley (DET) firms up in a screening position in Daniels' (ATL) path and does not deliver contact.
Following the shot fake, Thompson (DET) makes brief contact with Hunter's (ATL) arm that does not affect his SQBR.
The shot clock expires prior to the release of Hunter's (ATL) shot attempt.
Young (ATL) briefly grasps and releases Beasley's (DET) arm as he attempts to set the screen.
Daniels (ATL) makes clean contact with the ball to deflect it away from Cunningham (DET).
Thompson (DET) moves laterally into Young's (ATL) path and initiates body contact that affects Young's SQBR.
Daniels (ATL) maintains a legal guarding position during Cunningham's (DET) drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Krejci (ATL) firms up in a screening position in Thompson's (DET) path and does not deliver contact.
Beasley (DET) legally contests Young's (ATL) jump shot attempt.
Young (ATL) falls to the floor after the release of his jump shot attempt and the ensuing contact with Beasley (DET) is incidental.
Okongwu (ATL) is in a legal defensive position as the pass is thrown to Harris (DET).
